description: Keep a lesson you learned while fixing a three.js problem, so it comes back the next time the same message or question shows up (in three_lessons, three_explain, three_check and the review). Write it in general words: title (the lesson in one line) and fix are required; symptom, cause, test, topic, tags, rules, and `error` with the exact console or build message. Names, paths, e-mail addresses, links and code are taken out before it is stored, and the file never leaves this machine ($THREESMITH_HOME). The same title updates the lesson.

path.description: Project folder, or a file or folder in it (relative to the server's folder; default: the project).

name: three_lesson_add
title: Keep a lesson learned here
